column3: The assistant sometimes cites "PTO Policy 2023" instead of the current 2025 version. The 2023 document is still present in the SharePoint source.
There is no defined trigger for handing accommodation or protected-leave questions to a human. The assistant answers them directly.
Two employees asked the same expense question and were given different per-diem figures.
Response latency spikes to 8–10 seconds around 9:00 each morning.
IT changed the underlying model version last Tuesday. No notice was given to the workflow owner.
Some users in one region intermittently get an "authentication failed" error when opening the assistant.
The assistant answered a question about statutory maternity leave with specific legal detail about entitlements and notice periods.
Users have asked that the assistant also draft the leave-request email for them, not just answer the policy question.
